run_prefix_caching_demo: run the offline prefix caching example to compare baseline vs cached LLM generation
create_llm_without_caching: create an LLM instance without prefix caching enabled for baseline text generation
create_llm_with_caching: create an LLM instance with enable_prefix_caching set to True for cached generation
generate_with_sampling_params: generate text from prompts using an LLM and SamplingParams with temperature zero
cleanup_dist_env_and_memory: call cleanup_dist_env_and_memory to free GPU memory after deleting the LLM object
